changelog:
Starknet DeFi Toolkit v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Read ERC-20 token balances for any Starknet address using public JSON-RPC endpoints.
- Fetch live STRK and ETH token prices in USD.
- List liquidity pools from Ekubo (concentrated liquidity AMM) and JediSwap (classic AMM), including TVL data and reserves.
- Simulate token swaps using constant product or tick-based models.
- Generate Cairo 1 / Sierra contract skeletons for basic DeFi contracts (ERC-20, staking).
- No API keys required; read-only and simulation functions only.
